text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis

The pattern of double vision worsening with vertical gaze and significant fluctuation in weakness after activity but improving with rest is highly characteristic of Myasthenia Gravis. Do you experience any difficulty swallowing or speaking slurred words?
